answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the cedar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A trellis of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ocean of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing.
